observations: A dark-brimmed hat sits across the upper portion of the head, built from overlapping brown, olive, and red strokes with white highlight lines tracing the crown.

Dense yellow scribble lines spread across the cheeks and chin, layered over olive and muted red color fills, while the mouth area shows a dark opening ringed by short white marks suggesting upper and lower tooth rows.

Two arms extend toward the upper corners against the teal background, fingers spread, framing the face with thin scratchy strokes in ochre and red; loose light-blue horizontal marks fill the space around the figure.
reading: The face pushes forward, mouth open and arms flung wide, so the composition reads as a single outward thrust. Yellow scribble lines spread across the cheeks like static. The dark hat presses down while the arms pull up and out, setting those two forces against each other. The teal field is marked with loose horizontal strokes that keep the background from fully receding, holding the figure in a shallow space.
contextAngle: Within the owned numbered subset, this work sits between nnxyz #43 and nnxyz #64 by title order, not confirmed creation order. The teal field echoes nnxyz nnotb #197 from a separate owned collection.
